entities.name: Esbo
entities.description: Soldier of Femeref guarding the magistrate's villa, torn between duty and empathy.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Used diplomacy and mystical persuasion to enter the magistrate's estate.

events.summary: Niambi appeals to Esbo with a symbolic dream and her magic to plead her case about the Efravan caravan.
events.quote: She recounted a symbolic dream that positioned Esbo as the central figure

events.summary: Moved, Esbo allows Niambi entry into the estate.
events.quote: Esbo allowed Niambi entry into the estate.

relations.quote: Esbo was stationed at the entrance of the magistrate Sidar Teshunda ’s villa in Femeref
